topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Strange things, these flowers without words. Came this morn', left at the doorstep, no note to speak of the sender. 'Tis as if the earth itself offered them, silent and unassuming. I wondered if the Saints played a hand, sending a message through spring's bloom. But what is the message? I picked them up, the dew still clinging to petals of colors not seen in our fields. Such things unsettle the heart. The soil knows its seasons, but the heart? It's a different story, always guessing and hoping. I placed them on the windowsill, where the sunlight touches them, and they seem to ask, "What now? What tomorrow?"
